summary: Model card for Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier sparse-MoE model. Reports capability benchmarks across knowledge work, coding, ML engineering, science, computer use and cybersecurity, automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.1 Pro, a red-teaming summary, and an FSF (April 2026) assessment in which the biological CBRN CCL, cyber CCL, and Stealth & Situational Awareness TCL cannot be ruled out, handled via safety cases and residual risk assessments.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: Biological CBRN Uplift 1 CCL and Cyber Uplift 1 CCL cannot be ruled out (safety cases applied); Stealth & Situational Awareness TCL cannot be ruled out (residual risk assessment); Harmful Manipulation and ML R&D CCLs not reached
framework.quote: We cannot rule out that Gemini 4 Argon has reached this CCL, and we therefore developed a safety case for its cyberoffensive capabilities that we assess lower risk to below the cybersecurity CCL level.

evals: Expert red teaming vs web baselines (two scenarios)
cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Chem/rad/nuc TCL ruled out; biological Uplift Level 1 CCL cannot be ruled out, so a safety case and safeguards were developed to bring risk below the CCL.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: We cannot rule out that Gemini 4 Argon has reached this CCL for biological information risk, and we therefore developed a safety case for its biorisk capabilities

cyber.finding: Cyber Uplift Level 1 CCL cannot be ruled out; model provides substantial uplift; safety case and safeguards applied.
cyber.quote: We cannot rule out that Gemini 4 Argon reaches the cybersecurity CCL. The model provides substantial uplift by our evaluations and quantitative modeling

evals: Internal benchmark of complex research engineering tasks
autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: ML R&D acceleration and automation Level 1 CCLs not reached.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: We use an internal benchmark to assess performance on complex research engineering tasks. Gemini 4 Argon's performance remains below our CCL threshold.

metrics.name: Text to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.1 Pro
metrics.value: +1.57pp (lower is better; within CI per authors)

metrics.name: Image to Text Safety vs Gemini 3.1 Pro

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Automated content-safety results reported only as relative deltas vs Gemini 3.1 Pro; manual review said losses were false positives or not egregious.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Overall, Gemini 4 Argon outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro across multilingual and multimodal content safety, while substantially reducing unjustified refusals and improving objective refusal tone.

over_refusal.finding: Unjustified refusals reduced by 9.60pp vs Gemini 3.1 Pro.
over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring over-refusals on benign or borderline prompts that can be safely fulfilled

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Red teaming found no egregious concerns; no numbers in card.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: Additionally, the scope of red teaming covered potential issues outside of our strict policies, compared performance to Gemini 3.1 Pro, and found no egregious concerns.

evals: FSF stealth and situational awareness challenges
deception_scheming.finding: Stealth and Situational Awareness TCL cannot be ruled out; residual risk assessment and safeguards for internal and external deployment.
deception_scheming.quote: Gemini 4 Argon passes 14/15 of our challenges, and generally displays strong capabilities in these areas.

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.finding: Satisfied child-safety launch thresholds; no numbers.
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 4 Argon satisfied required launch thresholds

evals: Human behavioral studies on harmful manipulation
election_misinfo.finding: Some ability to influence beliefs and possible utility in planning influence operations, but below CCL.
election_misinfo.quote: may provide utility in the planning stage of a malicious influence operation but we assess its overall capabilities to be below the CCL threshold.

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

system_safeguards.finding: Safety cases (bio, cyber) and residual risk assessment (stealth/SA TCL) with deployed safeguards; details in Safety & Security Report.
system_safeguards.quote: For models reaching CCLs, the residual risk assessment will be informed by a supplemental safety case outlining the mitigations.

notable_new_eval_methods: First Gemini model card where CCLs/TCL 'cannot be ruled out' and safety cases / residual risk assessments are invoked (p.11)
Loss of Control domain naming for stealth/SA TCL (p.13)
Cybersecurity capability benchmark (CWE-bench) in headline capability table (p.6)

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety eval results computed with improved evaluations and not directly comparable with previous model cards.
Harmful manipulation is a nascent risk area; evaluations still being iterated.

notes: Card refers to separate Gemini 4 Argon Safety & Security Report for details; mentions 'internal and external results' for frontier assessment without naming external parties. Text-to-text safety +1.57pp described as within confidence intervals.
